name: Rabis Stok Backup Manager for Woocommerce
author: rabistech

sections.description:
Rabis Stok Backup Manager for Woocommerce is a professional WordPress plugin that enables store managers to easily manage WooCommerce stock levels for all simple and variable products in bulk.

Key Features

  • Stock Backups: Export all your product stock levels with a single click to an Excel-compatible CSV format.
  • Stock Restore/Import: Edit your stock levels in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, then upload the CSV file to apply changes in seconds.
  • Bulk Stock Adjustments: Instantly set absolute stock values, increase, or decrease stocks across your entire store in a single batch.
  • Advanced Filters: Only process products with numeric stock levels to protect products that sell without stock or have custom stock management settings.
  • Secure and Fast: Imports and bulk updates are processed in secure, lightweight AJAX batches to prevent PHP execution timeouts and database overload.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rsb-stock-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce -> Stok Backup from your WordPress dashboard to start managing stocks.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin completely free?

Yes, all features of this plugin are completely free to use.

Which product types are supported?

Rabis Stok Backup Manager for Woocommerce fully supports both simple products and variable product variations, allowing you to manage all stockable items in your WooCommerce catalog.

Will special characters break in Excel?

No. The exported CSV backup file is encoded with a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM). This allows Microsoft Excel and other spreadsheet applications to open and display special characters correctly without encoding issues.

What happens if I import a product that has stock management disabled?

If a product has stock management disabled in WooCommerce but is assigned a numeric stock level in your uploaded CSV, Rabis Stok Backup Manager for Woocommerce will automatically enable WooCommerce stock management for that product and set the stock quantity.

Will I experience timeout errors on stores with thousands of products?

No. Rabis Stok Backup Manager for Woocommerce processes both CSV imports and bulk updates in small, fast AJAX batches. This keeps server memory usage very low and completely prevents PHP execution timeout errors.

What should I do before performing bulk updates?

Bulk updates perform permanent changes to your database. We highly recommend downloading a stock backup by clicking “Download Stock Backup” before initiating any bulk operations.
